project.title: Benjamin Cowen Just Flipped Bullish

model.title: This Bear Is Now Bullish on Bitcoin | Jason Pizzino
model.mechanism: One recognised bear, one behavioural change, one instantly understood promise.

thesis_sentences: Benjamin Cowen warned that Bitcoin would top in Q4 2025, later disclosed selling much of his own stack, and stayed bearish into June 2026.
Now he is buying below $60K for the next bull market, even though he thinks the final cycle bottom may not arrive until October.

cards.label: This Bear Is Now Bullish
cards.source_title: This Bear Is Now Bullish on Bitcoin | Jason Pizzino
cards.quote: This Bear Is Now Bullish on Bitcoin
cards.why: Sets the click mechanism before evidence.
cards.missing: Benji has no proven packaging reference before the evidence.

cards.label: Benjamin Cowen's Calls vs Bitcoin Price
cards.source_title: Benjamin Cowen's Calls vs Bitcoin Price
cards.quote: Q4 top forecast. Confirmation arrived later. Sale disclosed. Bearish through June. Buying below $60K.
cards.shows: The full sell-to-buy change against Bitcoin price.
cards.why: Gives Benji the entire chronology in one glance.
cards.inspect: Six dated moments | price data checked 9 Aug 2026
cards.missing: The separate clips have to be combined mentally.

cards.label: Cowen forecast a Q4 cycle top and bear market
cards.source_title: Bitcoin: The Pattern That Historically Ended The Bull Market
cards.quote: and then goes into the market cycle top in Q4 of the post-halving year, which sets up the midterm-year bear market.
cards.shows: A Q4 top and bear-market forecast before the fall.
cards.why: Establishes a credible prior bearish call.
cards.missing: The arc starts after the fall.

cards.label: At the October high, Cowen still wanted confirmation
cards.quote: I'd like to see some daily closes actually above the prior wick high. We haven't actually seen that yet.
cards.shows: At the October high, he still wanted follow-through.
cards.why: Makes the chronology credible instead of pretending he nailed the exact candle.
cards.missing: The Q4 forecast can sound like an exact-day top call.

cards.label: Cowen later raised top-in odds to 60-70%
cards.source_title: Bitcoin Falls Below the 50 Week Moving Average
cards.quote: Given how late cycle it is, I would say there's probably a 60 to 70% chance that the top is already in.
cards.shows: His top view hardened after the later technical break.
cards.why: Shows when the forecast became a high-conviction top call.
cards.missing: There is no bridge from forecast to conviction.

cards.label: Cowen says his portfolio followed the bearish view
cards.source_title: Everyone Thinks the Bitcoin Cycle Is Dead… They're Wrong | Benjamin Cowen
cards.quote: And so because of that, I ended up selling off approximately that amount of my Bitcoin stack last year.
cards.shows: His portfolio followed his 70 to 80% bearish conviction.
cards.caution: This is a retrospective disclosure. Exact sale dates, prices, quantity, and transactions are not supplied.

cards.label: Cowen still called it the final bear-market stage in June
cards.source_title: Bitcoin Enters the 3rd Stage of the Bear Market
cards.quote: Today, we're going to talk about Bitcoin and how it has entered the third and what I think is the final stage of the bear market.
cards.shows: He still called it the final bear-market stage in June.
cards.why: Makes the reversal recent, not retrospective.
cards.missing: The arc skips the continued bearish phase.

cards.label: Cowen says the durable bottom may arrive around October
cards.source_title: Bitcoin: Where in the Cycle Are We?
cards.shows: October remained inside his expected bottom window.
cards.why: Explains why he can buy while allowing another low.
cards.missing: His remaining downside view is unclear.
cards.caution: This is a forecast, not confirmation that the bottom is already in.

cards.label: Cowen says he started buying below $60K
cards.source_title: Bitcoin: Where in the Cycle Are We?
cards.quote: I started buying a little bit back when we went below 60K.
cards.shows: He started buying after Bitcoin moved below $60K.
cards.why: Delivers the title and thumbnail promise.
cards.missing: The bullish behaviour change is unsupported.
cards.caution: Exact execution date, average price, and quantity are not supplied.

cards.label: Prior Rubicon HYPE statement
cards.source_title: Bitcoin’s top 5 Bull Market Signals are all pointing to one date... (don't miss it)
cards.quote: Even in my inner circle, I've been talking about HYPE for so long since it was literally down in the $20 range.
cards.shows: Benji publicly linked Inner Circle coverage to HYPE in the $20 range.
cards.why: Supports the succinct HYPE line in the CTA.
cards.missing: The original contemporaneous Inner Circle post is not attached.

cards.label: Prior Rubicon winter-opportunity statement
cards.source_title: Bitcoin’s top 5 Bull Market Signals are all pointing to one date... (don't miss it)
cards.quote: inside our inner circle, we've sent out opportunities almost at a higher ratio of success and multiples than last year when the market was green.
cards.shows: Benji previously made the winter-versus-green-market comparison in public.
cards.why: Provides the prior public basis for the comparative CTA line.
cards.missing: This is a retrospective statement, not an audited portfolio-return report.
